Title: Information on: How do I best hang a picture?...
To hang a picture properly, follow these steps:

1. Measure and mark the desired location on the wall for the picture's center or hanging hardware.
2. Use a level to ensure the marked spot is horizontal and vertical.
3. Drive a pilot hole into the wall at the marked spot using a hammer and a small nail or drill bit, depending on the type of wall.
4. Insert the appropriate picture hanger (e.g., toggle bolt, screw hook) into the pilot hole, following the manufacturer's instructions for installation.
5. Hang the picture on the hanger and adjust its position as needed to ensure it is level.
--- End Document 1 ---

Title: Information on: How do I hammer in a tack?...
Hammering in a tack involves using a small hammer and a tack hammer or a nail set for precision. Place the tack's point against the workpiece, hold it firmly with one hand, and strike the tack's shank with the hammer held at a 45-degree angle to the workpiece. Apply gentle yet firm blows until the tack is fully seated. Ensure proper alignment and avoid over-hammering to prevent damaging the workpiece or the tack.
--- End Document 3 ---

The crown of the anchor is then hauled up with a heavy tackle until one fluke can be hooked over the rail. This is known as "catting and fishing" the anchor.
